note: FitVids attaches the FitVids.js jQuery library site-wide (hook_page_attachments) to make embedded videos fluid. All state is the fitvids.settings config object: selectors (default '.node'), custom_vendors (default 'https://youtu.be'), ignore_selectors (default ''), each newline-separated. Admin form /admin/config/media/fitvids (route fitvids.admin, permission 'administer fitvids'). Medium cases read back a non-default selectors value and the custom_vendors/ignore_selectors from the live config; hard cases point FitVids at a new container selector and add a custom video vendor plus an ignore selector, verified against fitvids.settings. Config is owned by this module; scripts restore shipped defaults.

evals.prompt: Which config object stores the Drupal FitVids module's settings, and what are its three keys (with the default value of the one that selects which containers get responsive videos)?
evals.expected_output: Settings live in fitvids.settings with keys selectors (default '.node' - the CSS selectors of video containers), custom_vendors (default 'https://youtu.be' - extra iframe src prefixes), and ignore_selectors (default empty - videos to leave alone).

evals.prompt: Where is the FitVids settings form in the Drupal admin, what is its route, and which permission controls access?
evals.expected_output: The form is at Configuration > Media > FitVids (/admin/config/media/fitvids), route fitvids.admin, gated by the 'administer fitvids' permission.

evals.prompt: How does the FitVids module apply the FitVids.js behavior to a Drupal page - via a field formatter, a block, or something else - and how does a configured custom video provider reach the JavaScript?
evals.expected_output: It uses hook_page_attachments to attach the fitvids/fitvids and fitvids/init libraries on every page and export selectors/custom_vendors/ignore_selectors to drupalSettings.fitvids; a custom vendor like https://vimeo.com is turned into the selector iframe[src^="https://vimeo.com"]. It is not a formatter or block.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, FitVids has been pointed at a non-default container selector. Inspect the live configuration and state the CSS selector FitVids currently targets.
FitVids on this site has an extra video provider and an ignore selector configured. Inspect the live configuration and state the additional video provider and the ignored selector.
evals.expected_output: fitvids.settings custom_vendors is 'https://vimeo.com' and ignore_selectors is '.no-fit'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure FitVids so that it makes videos fluid inside containers matching the CSS selector '.content'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: fitvids.settings selectors contains '.content' (drush cset fitvids.settings selectors '.content', or via the settings form).

evals.prompt: Using the FitVids module on this site, add 'https://videopress.com' as an additional video provider and make FitVids ignore videos matching the selector '.slick-slider'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: fitvids.settings custom_vendors includes 'https://videopress.com' and ignore_selectors includes '.slick-slider'.
